optimizedContext.value:
# Cross-Platform Portability

## Rules
- All production code: equivalent on macOS, Linux, Windows; MUST NOT assume POSIX host/shell/FS layout; platform diffs isolated in one helper/adapter, MUST NOT leak to callers
- Paths: build/split/compare via `node:path` (`join`, `resolve`, `relative`, `dirname`, `basename`, `sep`); MUST NOT concat/split on hardcoded `/` or `\`
- Logical path IDs (index keys, manifests, locks): normalize to `/` before store/compare; convert to host path only when touching FS
- `path.win32`/`path.posix` only for deliberate platform-specific rules, never as host `path` replacement
- File URLs: `pathToFileURL`/`fileURLToPath`, not string concat
- Case: MUST NOT rely on FS case-sensitivity; case-only path diffs MUST NOT be distinct files on Windows/macOS; MUST NOT depend on on-disk casing match
- Names reaching disk: valid Windows+POSIX; forbid `< > : " | ? *`, control chars, trailing `.`/space, reserved devices (`CON`, `PRN`, `AUX`, `NUL`, `COM1`–`COM9`, `LPT1`–`LPT9` ±ext); validate at accept boundary
- Text: CRLF/CR/LF equivalent on read; hashes/markers/change-detect on LF-normalized content; write UTF-8 no BOM; readers tolerate BOM; MUST NOT use `os.EOL` for persisted format
- Processes: prefer `spawn`/`execFile` arg array, no shell; shell only for explicit shell cmds or Windows `*.cmd`/`*.bat`; no POSIX-only builtins/syntax (`printf`, `sleep`, `&&`-as-sh, `$VAR`) unless execution layer translates; `windowsHide` for non-interactive; account cmd vs POSIX quoting
- Permissions/symlinks: MUST NOT rely on POSIX `chmod`/exec/`0o000` for Windows-required behaviour; symlink features optional with copy/fallback when creation denied
- File lock/replace: MUST NOT assume open file deletable/renamable (Windows rejects); atomic write = temp in same dir + rename; retry briefly on `EBUSY`/`EPERM`/`EACCES`; keep paths short; MUST NOT depend on paths > Windows default limit
- Env/dirs: `os.homedir()`, `os.tmpdir()`, `process.cwd()`/config; MUST NOT hardcode `/tmp`, `/home/...`, `~`, `C:\`; env name lookups case-insensitive; `process.platform` in one isolated helper
- Enforcement: tests per `_global/testing`; gate via `_global/continuous-integration` 3-OS job; undocumented cross-OS behaviour without isolated adapter → reject in review

## Constraints
- Production code all packages; test rules in `_global/testing`
- No hardcoded path separators or absolute POSIX paths in production
- No shell / POSIX-only builtins by default for external programs
- Disk names Windows-valid incl. reserved devices
- Persisted text UTF-8 no BOM; LF-normalized comparison
- Platform-specific behaviour isolated in single helper/adapter
